name: an-extension-side-panel-opens-resizes-and-closes
description: A real unpacked extension with openPanelOnActionClick, pinned through the seeded Preferences. A left-click on its chip opens the native side panel on the edge opposite the sidebar. A tab switch keeps the window panel. A drag on the panel's grip widens it and stores the width. The header close button hides it. The light, dark and cyan-accent captures are the theme evidence. The panel is a card shaped like the page card: inset from the window edges, with rounded corners.

actions.note: gate: the startup tab committed, so the app is up
